LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REPETITION_COMPLA.zh_CN: 火过头就是这个下场，连八竿子打不着的新闻底下都有人在那儿复读……现在教人怎么屏蔽它的帖子，转发量都快赶上你这模因本身了。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REPETITION_COMPLA.en: Several popular discussions are packed with repeated uses of the meme, and users are collecting screenshots from unrelated posts while sharing filter instructions. That is a different sort of visibility: people are learning how to avoid the phrase. Repeating it still more may make it harder to find someone willing to join in.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_SOURCE_QUESTION_P.source: 追查出处让隐藏的伤害可以被讨论
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_SOURCE_QUESTION_P.zh_CN: 把最早带火这词的人扒个底朝天也好，免得大伙儿稀里糊涂替烂人扬名
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_SOURCE_QUESTION_P.en: Uncovering an early user's discriminatory remark makes reposters reconsider what reuse signals

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_SOURCE_QUESTION_N.source: 作者的旧话替所有转发者补上了未说的立场
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_SOURCE_QUESTION_N.zh_CN: 我就随手转个梗图乐呵一下，怎么突然还要替八百年前发帖的人背锅了
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_SOURCE_QUESTION_N.en: Reposting the meme may be mistaken for endorsing an early user’s views

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_SOURCE_QUESTION_T.zh_CN: 早期玩梗者黑历史被扒，网友争论跟风算不算站队
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_SOURCE_QUESTION_T.en: Early user's discriminatory statement sparks debate over continuing to use the meme

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_SOURCE_QUESTION_N.source: %s网友追出这条模因早期使用者的一段歧视性发言。转发者开始删除旧帖，争论集中在继续使用是否等于认同原作者。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_SOURCE_QUESTION_N.zh_CN: %s有网友顺藤摸瓜，扒出了最早带火这条模因的人曾发表过歧视言论。不少转发过的人赶紧连夜删帖，评论区正为接着玩梗算不算替那人站台吵成一团。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_SOURCE_QUESTION_N.en: Readers in %s trace the meme to an early user with a discriminatory statement. Reposters delete older posts as debate turns to whether reuse endorses the source.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_SOURCE_QUESTION_C.source: 出处争议会把表达与使用者一起拖进讨论。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_SOURCE_QUESTION_C.zh_CN: 最早玩这句话的人翻了车，连带着现在谁转发谁就得先写三百字免责声明……网上追起旧事来，连坐速度可比传播快多了。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_SOURCE_QUESTION_C.en: Readers uncovered a discriminatory remark by an early user, and reposters began deleting older posts. The dispute is about whether using a borrowed phrase also endorses its source. A repost on its own cannot tell us everything the person repeating it believes.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PUBLIC_CORRECTION.source: 原始记录帮助读者重新判断引用是否准确
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PUBLIC_CORRECTION.zh_CN: 完整原视频放出来就好办了，断章取义截出来的半句话确实该歇歇了
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PUBLIC_CORRECTION.en: Original footage and correction links under major reposts let readers check the quote’s context

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PUBLIC_CORRECTION.source: 转发速度比看完视频快了太多
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PUBLIC_CORRECTION.zh_CN: 原片前头铺垫了足足五分钟，哪有截出来的那五秒钟转起来带劲
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PUBLIC_CORRECTION.en: After original footage shows the quote came from another context, some readers drop that version

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PUBLIC_CORRECTION.source: 事实核查指出模因引用有误
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PUBLIC_CORRECTION.zh_CN: 核查账号放出完整原视频，证实模因引语系断章取义
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PUBLIC_CORRECTION.en: Fact-checking account publishes original footage showing meme quote came from another context

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PUBLIC_CORRECTION.source: %s事实核查账号公布原始视频，证明这条模因引用的那句话来自另一段情境。纠正链接被放在热门转载下，部分读者停止使用原版本。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PUBLIC_CORRECTION.zh_CN: %s一个事实核查账号放出了未剪辑的原始录像，证实这条模因里疯传的那句话其实截自完全相反的上下文。核查链接被刷上热转前排后，不少人默默停用了原版。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PUBLIC_CORRECTION.en: A fact-checking account in %s publishes footage showing that the meme quote came from a different context. Corrections appear under major reposts, and some readers stop using that version.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PUBLIC_CORRECTION.source: 具体的更正会改变具体的信任。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PUBLIC_CORRECTION.zh_CN: 核查号把完整录像放出来了，原来人家前半句根本不是那个意思……虽说已经有不少人默默删帖了，但我赌五毛钱，过两天肯定还有没看原片的人接着转。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PUBLIC_CORRECTION.en: A fact-checking account published original footage showing that the meme’s quote came from another context. Correction links appear under major reposts, and some readers have stopped using that version. Those links give people somewhere to check the context before deciding whether to repeat the quote themselves.

LOC_EVENT_CRITICAL_QUOTE_POSITIVE.source: 相同形式也能表达相反立场
LOC_EVENT_CRITICAL_QUOTE_POSITIVE.zh_CN: 一字不改照抄他们当初吹牛的原话，底下直接换上翻车现场，杀人诛心不过如此
LOC_EVENT_CRITICAL_QUOTE_POSITIVE.en: Critics keep the recognizable wording and swap the footage to turn praise into mockery

LOC_EVENT_CRITICAL_QUOTE_NEGATIVE.source: 曾经表示支持的一句话成了对支持者的回敬
LOC_EVENT_CRITICAL_QUOTE_NEGATIVE.zh_CN: 当初真心实意拿来加油打气的一句话，现在硬生生给他们玩成了阴阳怪气的脏词
LOC_EVENT_CRITICAL_QUOTE_NEGATIVE.en: The wording stays intact while opposing footage flips approval into ridicule

LOC_EVENT_CRITICAL_QUOTE_TITLE.source: 批评者借用这条模因反讽原来的支持者
LOC_EVENT_CRITICAL_QUOTE_TITLE.zh_CN: 批评者照搬模因原话，换上翻车画面反向嘲讽
LOC_EVENT_CRITICAL_QUOTE_TITLE.en: Critical community pairs original meme wording with opposing footage in mockery

LOC_EVENT_CRITICAL_QUOTE_NARRATIVE.source: %s一个批评者社群保留这条模因的句式，把它放到与原支持对象相反的画面上。新版本仍能被认出来，赞同的口吻却成了嘲讽。
LOC_EVENT_CRITICAL_QUOTE_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: %s一拨唱反调的网友原封不动留着这条模因的句式，偏偏把底图全换成了与原意唱反调的翻车现场。话还是那句熟话，听在耳朵里却全成了阴阳怪气。
LOC_EVENT_CRITICAL_QUOTE_NARRATIVE.en: A critical community in %s keeps the meme wording but places it over footage opposing its original subject. The form stays recognizable while approval turns into mockery.

LOC_EVENT_CRITICAL_QUOTE_COMMENT.source: 认得出原句，反转才会产生力量。
LOC_EVENT_CRITICAL_QUOTE_COMMENT.zh_CN: 最损的就是这种招数了，连标点符号都不改你的，光把底下的图一换，原先夸人的话当场变成打脸现场……偏偏大家还一眼就能认出是你的手笔。
LOC_EVENT_CRITICAL_QUOTE_COMMENT.en: A critical community kept the meme’s wording and placed it over footage opposing its original subject. The familiar words still suggest approval, but the footage makes that approval sound mocking. Recognizing the phrase is part of what makes the turn work.

LOC_EVENT_SEMANTIC_SPLIT_POSITIVE.source: 新的经验能让既有形式长出新的用途
LOC_EVENT_SEMANTIC_SPLIT_POSITIVE.zh_CN: 管它最早是聊什么的，拿来形容咱们这摊破事反正再贴切不过了
LOC_EVENT_SEMANTIC_SPLIT_POSITIVE.en: A new community applies the meme to everyday experiences beyond its original subject

LOC_EVENT_SEMANTIC_SPLIT_NEGATIVE.source: 所有人都在用同一句话，却未必在说同一件事
LOC_EVENT_SEMANTIC_SPLIT_NEGATIVE.zh_CN: 满屏刷的还是同一句话，点进去一看，新来这帮人聊的跟我们压根不是一码事
LOC_EVENT_SEMANTIC_SPLIT_NEGATIVE.en: Older users recognize the surface wording while disagreeing with newcomers on what it refers to

LOC_EVENT_SEMANTIC_SPLIT_TITLE.source: 新的社群给这条模因赋予另一层含义
LOC_EVENT_SEMANTIC_SPLIT_TITLE.zh_CN: 新圈子借走模因另起炉灶，新老受众各聊各话
LOC_EVENT_SEMANTIC_SPLIT_TITLE.en: New community gives familiar meme a different reference

LOC_EVENT_SEMANTIC_SPLIT_NARRATIVE.source: %s一个新接触到这条模因的社群，用它谈论原作没有涉及的生活经验。旧用户仍看得懂表面表达，双方对它所指的事情开始分歧。
LOC_EVENT_SEMANTIC_SPLIT_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: %s另一个圈子的网友把这条模因捡去吐槽他们自己的日常，跟最早那拨人聊的事压根不挨边。现在两边嘴里挂着同一句话，心里想的却早已是两码事了。
LOC_EVENT_SEMANTIC_SPLIT_NARRATIVE.en: A community newly encountering the meme in %s uses it for experiences outside its original subject. Older users recognize the surface form but disagree about what it now refers to.

LOC_EVENT_SEMANTIC_SPLIT_COMMENT.source: 语义分叉发生在共同形式仍然存在的时候。
LOC_EVENT_SEMANTIC_SPLIT_COMMENT.zh_CN: 新来这拨人把你的壳子借走了，里头装的完全是另一摊事……最逗的是老用户点进去还能看懂字面，聊上三句才发现两边根本不在一个频道。
LOC_EVENT_SEMANTIC_SPLIT_COMMENT.en: A community newly encountering the meme is using it for experiences the original never covered. Older users recognize the wording but disagree with them about what it refers to. Before deciding who has misunderstood whom, it is worth asking which experience each group is talking about.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CAPTION_SHORTENIN.source: 新的措辞让原本不熟悉句式的人也能看懂
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CAPTION_SHORTENIN.zh_CN: 把绕来绕去的原句拆成一句大白话，没追过前情的人一眼也能看明白在吵什么
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CAPTION_SHORTENIN.en: Turning the meme into a direct explanation lets new readers pick up the same meaning

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CAPTION_SHORTENIN.source: 意思还在，熟悉的那句话已经不在了
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CAPTION_SHORTENIN.zh_CN: 大白话是好懂了，原先那句拐着弯儿的灵魂腔调也跟着一块儿没了
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CAPTION_SHORTENIN.en: The underlying meaning survives, while the original wording is replaced in new replies

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CAPTION_SHORTENIN.source: 网友用直白的说法转述这条模因
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CAPTION_SHORTENIN.zh_CN: 网友抛开原句改用大白话转述，新说法反客为主
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CAPTION_SHORTENIN.en: Readers retell meme as direct explanation and continue with the new phrasing

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CAPTION_SHORTENIN.source: %s网友把这条模因转述成一段直接的说明，不再沿用原有句式。新读者能理解同一层意思，却开始用这套新措辞继续接话。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CAPTION_SHORTENIN.zh_CN: %s有网友嫌原句绕口，干脆用一段直白的大白话把里头的意思重讲了一遍。后进来的路人不用补课也能听懂，索性都顺着这句新编的大白话接着往下聊了。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CAPTION_SHORTENIN.en: Readers in %s retell the meme as a direct explanation, replacing its original wording. New readers understand the same meaning and continue using the new phrasing.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CAPTION_SHORTENIN.source: 表达换了一套说法，指向仍然可以保持。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CAPTION_SHORTENIN.zh_CN: 意思还是你那个意思，就是人家嫌原话绕，直接拿大白话给翻译了一遍……结果新来的人全跟着学那句省事的去了，你辛辛苦苦攒出来的金句倒没人念了。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CAPTION_SHORTENIN.en: Readers have paraphrased the meme into a direct explanation instead of keeping its original wording. New readers still take the same meaning from it, though they are continuing the conversation with the new phrasing rather than yours.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_IN_GROUP_SHORTHAN.source: 换一种说法也能把同一意思传给新人
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_IN_GROUP_SHORTHAN.zh_CN: 换成咱们圈里顺嘴的黑话一讲，群里那帮熟人秒懂，比原话带感多了
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_IN_GROUP_SHORTHAN.en: The group’s own wording can carry the same meaning to newcomers

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_IN_GROUP_SHORTHAN.source: 原作与复述听起来不同，指向却仍然相同
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_IN_GROUP_SHORTHAN.zh_CN: 被他们改成圈内黑话单飞出去之后，现在谁还记得最早是从哪句梗变来的
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_IN_GROUP_SHORTHAN.en: The group's own wording replaces the original expression and starts circulating on its own

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_IN_GROUP_SHORTHAN.source: 社群开始用自己的说法复述模因
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_IN_GROUP_SHORTHAN.zh_CN: 小圈子用自家黑话重编模因，新说法脱离原作单飞
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_IN_GROUP_SHORTHAN.en: Interest group retells meme in its own words as new phrasing circulates independently

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_IN_GROUP_SHORTHAN.source: %s一个兴趣社群把这条模因的意思用自己的说法重新讲了一遍。原来的表达被替换，大家仍围绕同一层含义接话，新措辞开始单独流传。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_IN_GROUP_SHORTHAN.zh_CN: %s一个兴趣小圈子把这条模因的意思揉进了自家的行话里重说了一遍，聊的还是那档子事，嘴里的词却全换了茬，这套新说法眼下已经脱离原帖单独传开了。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_IN_GROUP_SHORTHAN.en: An interest group in %s retells the meme meaning in its own words. The original expression is replaced while members keep discussing the same meaning; the new wording begins circulating on its own.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_IN_GROUP_SHORTHAN.source: 同一个意思，可能留下几种不同的表达。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_IN_GROUP_SHORTHAN.zh_CN: 小圈子最爱干这事了，非得把外头来的话回炉重造，换成他们自己人听得懂的行话才舒坦……你看，现在那句改头换面的版本自己跑得比原版还欢。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_IN_GROUP_SHORTHAN.en: An interest group restated the meme’s meaning in its own words, replacing the original expression while keeping the same point in discussion. The new wording is now circulating on its own. The familiar sentence is no longer needed for people in that exchange to refer to the same thing.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CONTEXT_REMOVED_P.source: 新的场景让形式获得了另一种可用的含义
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CONTEXT_REMOVED_P.zh_CN: 管它原帖前头写了什么，单截这一句出来怼对面那帮人简直百发百中
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CONTEXT_REMOVED_P.en: Cropping the meme into another dispute gives new readers a ready-made judgment to use

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CONTEXT_REMOVED_N.source: 没有变的字句也能被搬去指认别的人
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CONTEXT_REMOVED_N.zh_CN: 让营销号掐头去尾截剩半张图，好端端一句话硬是给当成了地图炮
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CONTEXT_REMOVED_N.en: With the surrounding context cut away, new readers take the meme as a judgment on another group

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CONTEXT_REMOVED_T.source: 脱离原场景的转载改变了指向
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CONTEXT_REMOVED_T.zh_CN: 营销号掐头去尾搬运截图，模因被当成站队新靶子
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CONTEXT_REMOVED_T.en: Reposting account cuts context and shifts the meme onto another group

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CONTEXT_REMOVED_N.source: %s一个搬运账号裁掉这条模因原有的前后文，把剩下的部分用在完全不同的争论里。新读者将它当成对另一群体的评价。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CONTEXT_REMOVED_N.zh_CN: %s一个搬运号把这条模因前后的铺垫全给裁没了，单拎出中间半句丢进了另一场毫不相干的骂战里，不明真相的路人当场把它认成了嘲讽另一群人的地图炮。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CONTEXT_REMOVED_N.en: A reposting account in %s cuts the surrounding context and uses the remaining meme in a different dispute. New readers take it as a judgment about another group.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CONTEXT_REMOVED_C.source: 语境被剪掉以后，剩下的空位会有人填上。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CONTEXT_REMOVED_C.zh_CN: 营销号截图那把剪刀你又不是第一天见，前因后果咔嚓一剪，好端端一句话转眼就替别人背上了骂名……偏偏看客就吃没头没尾这一套。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_CONTEXT_REMOVED_C.en: A reposting account cut away the surrounding context and dropped the remaining meme into a different dispute. The words did not change, but new readers took them as a judgment on another group. Someone repeating it from there may be passing on a judgment they never saw in the original setting.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_LOCAL_GLOSSARY_PO.source: 熟悉的地方经验为表达提供新的共同理解
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_LOCAL_GLOSSARY_PO.zh_CN: 借这词来叫咱们本地这摊烂摊子太顺嘴了，省得每次都要从头解释半天
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_LOCAL_GLOSSARY_PO.en: Reinterpreting the meme through local experience gives the community a shared term for its own situation

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_LOCAL_GLOSSARY_NE.source: 名字借来了，原来那件事已经不在场
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_LOCAL_GLOSSARY_NE.zh_CN: 传到他们本地人嘴里全变味了，早没人记得这词当初是专指哪桩事的了
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_LOCAL_GLOSSARY_NE.en: The original target becomes a broad label for a related but different local situation

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_LOCAL_GLOSSARY_TI.source: 本地社群用模因给自己的处境命名
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_LOCAL_GLOSSARY_TI.zh_CN: 地方社区借模因吐槽本地顽疾，专指旧梗变成日常泛称
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_LOCAL_GLOSSARY_TI.en: Local community reinterprets meme through local experience and broadens its target

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_LOCAL_GLOSSARY_NA.source: %s一个地方社群用本地经验重新解释这条模因。原来的对象变成泛指，大家开始用它描述一种相似却不相同的处境。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_LOCAL_GLOSSARY_NA.zh_CN: %s一个地方论坛把这条模因拿去套用自家的日常槽点。叫得久了，早先特指那桩事的名字彻底变成了当地人的口头泛称，但凡碰上差不多的糟心场面都能拿它顶一句。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_LOCAL_GLOSSARY_NA.en: A local community in %s reinterprets the meme through local experience. Its original object becomes a broader label for a related but different situation.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_LOCAL_GLOSSARY_CO.source: 本地化有时会连同指向一起改写。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_LOCAL_GLOSSARY_CO.zh_CN: 本来是冲着具体一桩事去的，结果让当地人拿去当日常口头禅使唤了……也好，能在外地生下根来，哪怕意思跑偏半里地也算本事。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_LOCAL_GLOSSARY_CO.en: A local community reinterpreted the meme through its own experience, turning the original target into a broader label for a related but distinct local situation. That slight shift in reference is what lets the phrase take root in local talk.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PERSONAL_LEDGER_P.source: 共同使用让个人经历有了稳定的表达搭配
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PERSONAL_LEDGER_P.zh_CN: 每次发加班餐和绩效表顺手配一句它，不用多吐半个脏字同事就懂了
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PERSONAL_LEDGER_P.en: Repeatedly pairing the meme with overtime and ranking jokes gives office workers a steady shorthand

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PERSONAL_LEDGER_N.source: 原来的意思被每次一起出现的抱怨拉走了
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PERSONAL_LEDGER_N.zh_CN: 硬是被打工人跟加班表焊死在一块儿了，现在在别的地方发这句都串味
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PERSONAL_LEDGER_N.en: Repeated pairing with overtime and performance rankings draws a broad phrase toward workplace commentary

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PERSONAL_LEDGER_T.source: 这条模因与职场梗形成固定搭配
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PERSONAL_LEDGER_T.zh_CN: 打工人高频混搭加班与绩效吐槽，模因被焊死在职场语境
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PERSONAL_LEDGER_T.en: Meme forms recurring pairing with overtime and performance-ranking jokes

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PERSONAL_LEDGER_N.source: %s上班族反复把这条模因与加班、绩效排名的表达放在一起使用。新读者逐渐把原本宽泛的句式理解成对职场规则的评价。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PERSONAL_LEDGER_N.zh_CN: %s大批上班族一晒加班记录和末位淘汰表就顺手带上这条模因。见得次数多了，后来的网友干脆把它当成了专门阴阳职场考勤的固定台词。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PERSONAL_LEDGER_N.en: Workers in %s repeatedly pair the meme with overtime and performance-ranking jokes. New readers begin reading the formerly broad phrase as a comment on workplace rules.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PERSONAL_LEDGER_C.source: 经常相邻的表达，会开始分享同一层含义。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PERSONAL_LEDGER_C.zh_CN: 本来挺宽泛的一句话，非让那帮苦命上班族天天跟加班表绑一块儿发，现在好了，我一看见这几个字都条件反射想先看一眼打卡机。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_PERSONAL_LEDGER_C.en: Workers kept pairing the meme with jokes about overtime and performance rankings. After seeing them together repeatedly, new readers began treating a once-broad phrase as a comment on workplace rules. The recurring pairing gives newcomers a context even if they never saw the phrase used more broadly.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REMIX_COMPARISON_.source: 互相引用让两种表达共享新的联想
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REMIX_COMPARISON_.zh_CN: 两张毫不相干的老梗拼在一个视频里意外地搭，现在刷出前半句底下全在默契接下联
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REMIX_COMPARISON_.en: After repeated reposts beside a before-and-after format, either half calls up the whole pairing

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REMIX_COMPARISON_.source: 拆开任意一边，观众仍会自动补上另一边
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REMIX_COMPARISON_.zh_CN: 硬跟那套对比图绑成了连体婴，想单独发一句都躲不开底下跟风补下半截的
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REMIX_COMPARISON_.en: Show either half, and viewers supply the other in their heads

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REMIX_COMPARISON_.source: 两套梗被剪进同一个对照模板
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REMIX_COMPARISON_.zh_CN: 创作者将两套梗混剪成连体搭档，刷半句自动带出下半截
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REMIX_COMPARISON_.en: Meme and comparison format merge into a recognizable pairing

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REMIX_COMPARISON_.source: %s创作者把这条模因与另一套“前后对照”的表达并排剪辑。多次转载后，观众开始用其中任意半句唤起整个组合。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REMIX_COMPARISON_.zh_CN: %s不少二创作者把这条模因和另一套流行的“前后对比”梗并排剪进同一个视频。来回搬运多了以后，现在评论区只要有人敲出前半句，楼下不用约就会整整齐齐补上另一半。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REMIX_COMPARISON_.en: Creators in %s place the meme beside a before-and-after format. After repeated reposting, viewers use either half to invoke the whole combination.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REMIX_COMPARISON_.source: 合流需要反复共现，单次拼贴还不够。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REMIX_COMPARISON_.zh_CN: 两个八竿子打不着的梗让人硬凑成了一对，现在跟春联似的，上联刚露头，评论区自动就把下联给续上了……你想拆都拆不开了。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_REMIX_COMPARISON_.en: Creators placed the meme beside a before-and-after format, and after repeated reposting viewers now use either half to call up the whole combination. Repeated co-occurrence bound the two formats together until one automatically brings the other to mind.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_EXIT_PHRASE_POSIT.source: 共同暗号让退出争论不必重新解释
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_EXIT_PHRASE_POSIT.zh_CN: 评论区碰到胡搅蛮缠的人懒得多费唾沫，甩出这句带尾巴的暗号直接体面退场
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_EXIT_PHRASE_POSIT.en: Adding a fixed ending gives users a recognizable way to step out of an overlong argument

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_EXIT_PHRASE_NEGAT.source: 接话的邀请也被改写成了不想再接话
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_EXIT_PHRASE_NEGAT.zh_CN: 以前发出来是找人一块儿聊天的，现在倒好，谁发这句就等于直接把门摔上了
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_EXIT_PHRASE_NEGAT.en: A phrase that once invited replies now signals that its user is done

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_EXIT_PHRASE_TITLE.source: 新的收尾句把模因变成退出暗号
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_EXIT_PHRASE_TITLE.zh_CN: 网友给模因接上固定散场句，吵架太累时拿来关麦走人
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_EXIT_PHRASE_TITLE.en: Readers add fixed ending to meme to signal leaving an argument

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_EXIT_PHRASE_NARRA.source: %s网友给这条模因加上一句固定收尾，在争论太久时用它表示不再继续。原本引人接话的表达开始承担结束对话的功能。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_EXIT_PHRASE_NARRA.zh_CN: %s网友给这条模因后头续上了一句固定的送客话，专门留着在评论区拉扯太久、懒得再吵的时候甩出来封口。原先招人接茬的开场白，就这么变成了关麦散场的信号。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_EXIT_PHRASE_NARRA.en: Readers in %s add a fixed ending to the meme to signal leaving an overlong argument. A phrase that invited replies begins serving as a way to end them.

LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_EXIT_PHRASE_COMME.source: 收尾改变了这句话在对话里的用途。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_EXIT_PHRASE_COMME.zh_CN: 好好的开场白让人家接了截送客的尾巴，现在谁在楼里甩出这句，意思就是老子不伺候了……在网上吵架，能体面撤退确实也是刚需。
LOC_EVENT_TRANSMISSION_EXIT_PHRASE_COMME.en: Readers added a fixed ending to the meme and now use it when an argument drags on too long. With that ending attached, a phrase that used to invite replies has taken on the job of ending the exchange.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_WAR_THREE_NARRATIVE.source: 第三次世界大战爆发。人口急剧减少，三天内将无人存活。投放与编辑已停止。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_WAR_THREE_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: 第三次世界大战爆发。各国人口骤减，整张地图将在三天内彻底归于死寂，投放与编辑已全部停止。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_WAR_THREE_NARRATIVE.en: World War III has broken out. Populations are falling rapidly, and the map will fall silent within three days. Deployment and editing have ended.

LOC_EVENT_WORLD_WAR_THREE_COMMENT.source: 先看仍有人生活的地方；模因需要有人接住。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_WAR_THREE_COMMENT.zh_CN: 机器都停了……趁地图上还有几盏灯亮着，最后看一眼还有人在的地方吧，毕竟没人活着，什么模因都传不下去了。
LOC_EVENT_WORLD_WAR_THREE_COMMENT.en: Watch where people still live. A meme needs someone to carry it.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_ALDEN_NARRATI.source: 港口译员把同一份船期译成几种版本，随信夹来一本日常短语册。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_ALDEN_NARRATI.zh_CN: 港口译员把同一份船期译成几种版本，随信夹来一本日常短语册。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_ALDEN_NARRATI.en: Harbor interpreters circulate several versions of the sailing schedule, with a pocket phrasebook enclosed.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_VERESK_NARRAT.source: 车站把旧广播录音整理上网。认出家乡口音的乘客逐句补上字幕。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_VERESK_NARRAT.zh_CN: 车站把旧广播录音整理上网。认出家乡口音的乘客逐句补上字幕。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_VERESK_NARRAT.en: An old station uploads its announcements. Passengers recognize familiar accents and supply the missing captions.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_LINDAL_NARRAT.source: 流动图书车驶进山谷，读者在借书单背面写下常用的问候。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_LINDAL_NARRAT.zh_CN: 流动图书车驶进山谷，读者在借书单背面写下常用的问候。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_LINDAL_NARRAT.en: A library van reaches the valley. Readers fill the backs of loan slips with everyday greetings.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_MARASU_NARRAT.source: 几座岛上的渔民合印潮汐表，给各港口的地名加上当地读音。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_MARASU_NARRAT.zh_CN: 几座岛上的渔民合印潮汐表，给各港口的地名加上当地读音。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_MARASU_NARRAT.en: Fishers print a shared tide table, adding local pronunciations beside each harbor name.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_SERRANOVA_NAR.source: 夜班长途车上，乘客争着教司机念对新站名，录音在沿线流传。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_SERRANOVA_NAR.zh_CN: 夜班长途车上，乘客争着教司机念对新站名，录音在沿线流传。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_SERRANOVA_NAR.en: Passengers on the night coach teach the driver the new stop names. Their recording travels along the route.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_ORUVIA_NARRAT.source: 渡轮恢复通航，售票员把两岸乘客常问的话写成了小册。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_ORUVIA_NARRAT.zh_CN: 渡轮恢复通航，售票员把两岸乘客常问的话写成了小册。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_ORUVIA_NARRAT.en: Ferry services resume. Ticket clerks compile a booklet of questions heard on both shores.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_NASHIR_NARRAT.source: 水井修好后，工匠寄来一封答谢信，信旁逐行标着读音。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_NASHIR_NARRAT.zh_CN: 水井修好后，工匠寄来一封答谢信，信旁逐行标着读音。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_NASHIR_NARRAT.en: After repairing the well, its builders send a thank-you letter with pronunciation notes in the margin.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_SOLERIA_NARRA.source: 沿海小影院征集本地方言配音，一段对白引来许多版本。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_SOLERIA_NARRA.zh_CN: 沿海小影院征集本地方言配音，一段对白引来许多版本。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_SOLERIA_NARRA.en: A small cinema invites local voice-overs. One exchange acquires a surprising number of versions.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_AVENDON_NARRA.source: 网络词典开放编辑。几位常客为一句招呼的语气争论到深夜。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_AVENDON_NARRA.zh_CN: 网络词典开放编辑。几位常客为一句招呼的语气争论到深夜。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_AVENDON_NARRA.en: An online dictionary opens to contributions. Regular editors debate the tone of a greeting late into the night.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_RHENIVIA_NARR.source: 河谷的工坊联印学徒手册，把口授多年的步骤记了下来。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_RHENIVIA_NARR.zh_CN: 河谷的工坊联印学徒手册，把口授多年的步骤记了下来。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_RHENIVIA_NARR.en: Workshops publish an apprentice handbook, writing down instructions passed on by ear for years.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_MEHRAN_NARRAT.source: 说书人带来一段祖辈传下的故事，听众把最喜欢的句子抄在票根上。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_MEHRAN_NARRAT.zh_CN: 说书人带来一段祖辈传下的故事，听众把最喜欢的句子抄在票根上。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_MEHRAN_NARRAT.en: A storyteller performs an inherited tale. Listeners copy favorite lines onto their tickets.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_CANTALIA_NARR.source: 街坊会议录音公开后，志愿者做出带停顿标记的逐字稿。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_CANTALIA_NARR.zh_CN: 街坊会议录音公开后，志愿者做出带停顿标记的逐字稿。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_CANTALIA_NARR.en: Volunteers transcribe a neighborhood meeting, marking the pauses as carefully as the words.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_VISHARA_NARRA.source: 雨季开学，老师寄来一张双语通知，孩子在边上补满了注音。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_VISHARA_NARRA.zh_CN: 雨季开学，老师寄来一张双语通知，孩子在边上补满了注音。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_VISHARA_NARRA.en: School opens in the rainy season. A bilingual notice arrives covered in a child’s pronunciation notes.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_STUDENTS_NARRATI.source: 考试前的自习室里，一句吐槽从桌角传到了班级群。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_STUDENTS_NARRATI.zh_CN: 考试前的自习室里，一句吐槽从桌角传到了班级群。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_STUDENTS_NARRATI.en: Before the exams, a scribbled complaint makes its way from a desk corner to the class chat.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_CULTURE_FANS_NAR.source: 演出散场，观众仍在门口交换自己记住的台词。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_CULTURE_FANS_NAR.zh_CN: 演出散场，观众仍在门口交换自己记住的台词。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_CULTURE_FANS_NAR.en: Outside the theater, the audience keeps trading lines remembered from the performance.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_AGRICULTURAL_WOR.source: 收购站挂起留言板，种植户在价格表旁写下这季的遭遇。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_AGRICULTURAL_WOR.zh_CN: 收购站挂起留言板，种植户在价格表旁写下这季的遭遇。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_AGRICULTURAL_WOR.en: Growers add accounts of their season beside the prices on the collection depot’s noticeboard.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_INDUSTRIAL_WORKE.source: 工人把一道难题画进交接本，下一班接着补全了解法。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_INDUSTRIAL_WORKE.zh_CN: 工人把一道难题画进交接本，下一班接着补全了解法。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_INDUSTRIAL_WORKE.en: A worker sketches a stubborn fault in the handover book. The next shift finishes the solution.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_SERVICE_WORKERS_.source: 深夜打烊，店员把顾客的奇怪要求写在作废的小票背面。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_SERVICE_WORKERS_.zh_CN: 深夜打烊，店员把顾客的奇怪要求写在作废的小票背面。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_SERVICE_WORKERS_.en: At closing time, staff jot down the day’s oddest requests on voided receipts.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_HEALTH_WORKERS_N.source: 诊室开始用一页纸交班。最先被大家记住的，是提醒休息的那句话。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_HEALTH_WORKERS_N.zh_CN: 诊室开始用一页纸交班。最先被大家记住的，是提醒休息的那句话。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_HEALTH_WORKERS_N.en: The clinic adopts a one-page handover. The line everyone remembers is the reminder to take a break.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_EDUCATORS_NARRAT.source: 备课室传来一张短笺，老师们在上面接着写课堂里的新发现。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_EDUCATORS_NARRAT.zh_CN: 备课室传来一张短笺，老师们在上面接着写课堂里的新发现。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_EDUCATORS_NARRAT.en: A note circulates through the staff room. Teachers add discoveries from their classrooms.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_SMALL_BUSINESS_N.source: 街道施工，店主们建群商量送货路线，顺便交换各自的招牌话。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_SMALL_BUSINESS_N.zh_CN: 街道施工，店主们建群商量送货路线，顺便交换各自的招牌话。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_SMALL_BUSINESS_N.en: During roadworks, shopkeepers coordinate deliveries in a new chat and trade their favorite sales pitches.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_TECH_WORKERS_NAR.source: 一张深夜故障单附上了极短的注释，早班同事一眼就懂。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_TECH_WORKERS_NAR.zh_CN: 一张深夜故障单附上了极短的注释，早班同事一眼就懂。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_TECH_WORKERS_NAR.en: A late-night incident ticket carries a very short note. The morning team understands it immediately.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_RETIREES_NARRATI.source: 公园翻修，常坐同一张长椅的人把告示改成了自己的聊天话题。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_RETIREES_NARRATI.zh_CN: 公园翻修，常坐同一张长椅的人把告示改成了自己的聊天话题。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_RETIREES_NARRATI.en: During park repairs, the regulars at one bench turn the closure notice into their morning conversation.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_DIASPORAS_NARRAT.source: 远方的亲友隔着时差一起做饭，旧称呼和新说法在通话里交错。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_DIASPORAS_NARRAT.zh_CN: 远方的亲友隔着时差一起做饭，旧称呼和新说法在通话里交错。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_DIASPORAS_NARRAT.en: Relatives cook together across time zones, mixing old family names with newly learned expressions.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_IDENTITY_NARRATI.source: 登记表增加了自填称呼一栏，人们讨论起该如何介绍自己。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_IDENTITY_NARRATI.zh_CN: 登记表增加了自填称呼一栏，人们讨论起该如何介绍自己。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_IDENTITY_NARRATI.en: A form adds a space for a preferred name. People begin discussing how they introduce themselves.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_LANGUAGE_NARRATI.source: 字幕组开放校订，一句难译的笑话收到了十几种建议。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_LANGUAGE_NARRATI.zh_CN: 字幕组开放校订，一句难译的笑话收到了十几种建议。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_LANGUAGE_NARRATI.en: A captioning team asks for corrections. One difficult joke draws a dozen suggestions.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_TRUST_NARRATIVE.source: 一则消息反复转发后，最早的发帖人贴出了完整记录。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_TRUST_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: 一则消息反复转发后，最早的发帖人贴出了完整记录。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_TRUST_NARRATIVE.en: After a message spreads widely, its first author publishes the complete record.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_HOUSING_NARRATIV.source: 房东重印租约，租客在群里逐条对照新的条款。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_HOUSING_NARRATIV.zh_CN: 房东重印租约，租客在群里逐条对照新的条款。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_HOUSING_NARRATIV.en: A landlord reprints the lease. Tenants compare the revised terms in their chat.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_HEALTHCARE_NARRA.source: 社区诊所更换预约办法，候诊的人互相说明怎样挂上号。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_HEALTHCARE_NARRA.zh_CN: 社区诊所更换预约办法，候诊的人互相说明怎样挂上号。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_HEALTHCARE_NARRA.en: A neighborhood clinic changes its booking system. Patients explain the new procedure to one another.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_CLIMATE_NARRATIV.source: 连续几天闷热，居民把窗边的温度读数贴进同一张表。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_CLIMATE_NARRATIV.zh_CN: 连续几天闷热，居民把窗边的温度读数贴进同一张表。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_CLIMATE_NARRATIV.en: During several muggy days, residents combine the temperatures recorded at their windows.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_ENERGY_NARRATIVE.source: 计划停电的通知贴出来，商户开始安排冰柜和夜间照明。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_ENERGY_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: 计划停电的通知贴出来，商户开始安排冰柜和夜间照明。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_ENERGY_NARRATIVE.en: A power-cut notice goes up. Shopkeepers make arrangements for freezers and evening lights.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_FOOD_NARRATIVE.source: 市场试吃摊前排起队，不同的家常做法被写在包装纸上。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_FOOD_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: 市场试吃摊前排起队，不同的家常做法被写在包装纸上。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_FOOD_NARRATIVE.en: A tasting stall draws a queue. Customers write their own recipes on the wrapping paper.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_TRANSPORT_NARRAT.source: 末班车调整时刻，晚归的人把新的换乘办法传给同伴。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_TRANSPORT_NARRAT.zh_CN: 末班车调整时刻，晚归的人把新的换乘办法传给同伴。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_TRANSPORT_NARRAT.en: The last bus changes its timetable. Late commuters pass around their new connections.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_MIGRATION_NARRAT.source: 街坊迎来几户新住户，接待处把常见问题整理成多语便条。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_MIGRATION_NARRAT.zh_CN: 街坊迎来几户新住户，接待处把常见问题整理成多语便条。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_MIGRATION_NARRAT.en: New households arrive. The welcome desk prepares multilingual notes answering common questions.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_TOURISM_NARRATIV.source: 淡季旅店推出步行地图，住客在背面留下沿途的发现。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_TOURISM_NARRATIV.zh_CN: 淡季旅店推出步行地图，住客在背面留下沿途的发现。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_TOURISM_NARRATIV.en: An inn offers walking maps in the quiet season. Guests record discoveries on the back.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_TRADE_NARRATIVE.source: 一批货延迟抵港，买卖双方逐行核对货单和承诺的日期。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_TRADE_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: 一批货延迟抵港，买卖双方逐行核对货单和承诺的日期。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_TRADE_NARRATIVE.en: A delayed shipment leads buyers and sellers to compare the manifest with the promised dates.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_SCIENCE_NARRATIV.source: 观测站公布一页笔记，爱好者尝试复现其中的测量。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_SCIENCE_NARRATIV.zh_CN: 观测站公布一页笔记，爱好者尝试复现其中的测量。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_SCIENCE_NARRATIV.en: An observatory publishes a page of notes. Enthusiasts try to reproduce its measurements.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_CARE_NARRATIVE.source: 邻居排出轮值表，轮流替需要帮助的住户买菜和取药。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_CARE_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: 邻居排出轮值表，轮流替需要帮助的住户买菜和取药。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_CARE_NARRATIVE.en: Neighbors arrange turns collecting groceries and medicine for residents who need help.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_PUBLIC_SAFETY_NA.source: 一处路口的照明坏了，居民附上夜间照片申请报修。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_PUBLIC_SAFETY_NA.zh_CN: 一处路口的照明坏了，居民附上夜间照片申请报修。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_PUBLIC_SAFETY_NA.en: Residents submit night photographs to request repairs to the lights at a crossing.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_ALDEN_COMMENT.source: 船期会改，码头上的叫法倒留得久。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_ALDEN_COMMENT.zh_CN: 船期表三天两头改，码头工人嘴里的老叫法倒是一直没变过……随信夹来的小册子你先收着。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_ALDEN_COMMENT.en: Schedules change. Harbor names tend to linger.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_VERESK_COMMEN.source: 听惯的广播，换个人念就觉得路也变了。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_VERESK_COMMEN.zh_CN: 天天坐同一趟车的人耳朵都尖，广播换个人念，闭着眼都能觉出不对味来。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_VERESK_COMMEN.en: A different voice on the announcements can make the route feel unfamiliar.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_LINDAL_COMMEN.source: 借书单背面常有比书目更亲近的话。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_LINDAL_COMMEN.zh_CN: 正经书没翻两页，借书卡背面的涂鸦倒是让人传阅了一路。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_LINDAL_COMMEN.en: The back of a loan slip can sound warmer than its list of titles.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_MARASU_COMMEN.source: 有些地名，要出过海才听得出差别。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_MARASU_COMMEN.zh_CN: 隔座岛就换个念法，没跟渔船跑过一趟的人照着地图念准保露怯。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_MARASU_COMMEN.en: Some place names sound different once you have sailed past them.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_SERRANOVA_COM.source: 司机学会之前，乘客已经替他报站了。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_SERRANOVA_COM.zh_CN: 一车人七嘴八舌教司机念站名，我猜司机到终点站耳朵都快起茧了。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_SERRANOVA_COM.en: The passengers are calling the stops before the driver learns them.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_ORUVIA_COMMEN.source: 对岸同一句问路，尾音未必一样。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_ORUVIA_COMMEN.zh_CN: 售票窗口天天听南北两头的口音，攒出来的小抄可比正经教材管用多了。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_ORUVIA_COMMEN.en: The same question may end on a different note across the water.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_NASHIR_COMMEN.source: 信上的注音，也记着写信人的耐心。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_NASHIR_COMMEN.zh_CN: 生怕收信的人念劈叉了，还在旁边一行行标上读音，这工匠也是个实在人。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_NASHIR_COMMEN.en: The pronunciation notes record the writer’s patience too.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_SOLERIA_COMME.source: 大家笑出声的地方，并不总在同一秒。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_SOLERIA_COMME.zh_CN: 同一段台词换几种方言配音，连全场的笑点都能往前挪两秒或者往后慢半拍。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_SOLERIA_COMME.en: The laughter does not always arrive at the same second.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_AVENDON_COMME.source: 一句早上好，也够词典编辑忙上一晚。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_AVENDON_COMME.zh_CN: 为了一句“早上好”到底是客套还是阴阳怪气，这几位老兄硬是吵到了后半夜……闲得挺敬业。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_AVENDON_COMME.en: A single good morning can keep dictionary editors up all night.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_RHENIVIA_COMM.source: 师傅说得太快的地方，学徒终于有字可查。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_RHENIVIA_COMM.zh_CN: 以前老师傅嘴里嘟囔太快听不清的地方，印成册子总算不用再硬着头皮去问第二遍了。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_RHENIVIA_COMM.en: An apprentice can finally look up the instruction a master says too quickly.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_MEHRAN_COMMEN.source: 票根小，记住的那句倒很长。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_MEHRAN_COMMEN.zh_CN: 那么丁点儿大一张票根，硬是密密麻麻抄了一整句词上去，眼神真好。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_MEHRAN_COMMEN.en: The ticket is small; the remembered line takes up more room.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_CANTALIA_COMM.source: 停顿也抄下来，才听得见是谁在犹豫。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_CANTALIA_COMM.zh_CN: 连谁半截卡壳、谁叹了口气都老老实实标在稿子上，看字就跟坐现场似的。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_CANTALIA_COMM.en: Keep the pauses and you can hear who hesitated.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_VISHARA_COMME.source: 孩子的注音，比通知写得密。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_VISHARA_COMME.zh_CN: 小孩子在空白处歪歪扭扭标的注音，比老师印的通知正文占的地方还大。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_LANGUAGE_VISHARA_COMME.en: The child’s notes are denser than the notice itself.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_STUDENTS_COMMENT.source: 能传到别班的便签，通常写得够短。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_STUDENTS_COMMENT.zh_CN: 复习到头昏脑涨的时候，一张桌角传过来的废话纸条比什么鸡汤都提神。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_STUDENTS_COMMENT.en: A note that reaches another class is usually short enough to carry.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_CULTURE_FANS_COM.source: 灯已经关了，台词还在门外接着演。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_CULTURE_FANS_COM.zh_CN: 场馆大灯都熄了还不肯走，聚在台阶底下对台词的那拨人，回去肯定还得发长评。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_CULTURE_FANS_COM.en: The lights are out, but the lines keep going outside.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_AGRICULTURAL_WOR.source: 价格表只写数字，留言板把那一季补全了。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_AGRICULTURAL_WOR.zh_CN: 收购牌上就冷冰冰几个数，想知道今年地里到底好不好伺候，还得看旁边木板上的牢骚。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_AGRICULTURAL_WOR.en: The prices give the numbers. The messages supply the season.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_INDUSTRIAL_WORKE.source: 交接本翻到最后，常能找到前人的办法。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_INDUSTRIAL_WORKE.zh_CN: 夜班没修利索的毛病画个草图留给早班，省得两拨人见面还得扯嗓子比划半天。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_INDUSTRIAL_WORKE.en: Turn far enough through a handover book and an earlier solution often appears.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_SERVICE_WORKERS_.source: 作废的小票，也能把一天记得很准。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_SERVICE_WORKERS_.zh_CN: 要是把柜台打废的小票背面全订成册，估计比市面上一半喜剧片都精彩。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_SERVICE_WORKERS_.en: A voided receipt can still keep an accurate account of a day.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_HEALTH_WORKERS_C.source: 交班时能说清的一句话，值一夜安稳。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_HEALTH_WORKERS_C.zh_CN: 忙了一宿的人哪有工夫看长篇大论，交班纸上最顶用的永远是最后那句提醒。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_HEALTH_WORKERS_C.en: A clear sentence at handover is worth a calmer night.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_EDUCATORS_COMMEN.source: 同一节课，隔壁教室可能有另一种讲法。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_EDUCATORS_COMMEN.zh_CN: 办公室里传一圈的便签，到最后多半都在吐槽今天班上哪个学生又接了句神仙下联。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_EDUCATORS_COMMEN.en: The next classroom may have another way of teaching the same lesson.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_SMALL_BUSINESS_C.source: 送货车绕了路，店主的消息反而走得更近。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_SMALL_BUSINESS_C.zh_CN: 本来建群是为了通气哪条路没挖断，聊着聊着全开始互相偷师门口招牌怎么写了。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_SMALL_BUSINESS_C.en: The vans take a detour; the shopkeepers’ messages take a shorter route.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_TECH_WORKERS_COM.source: 注释短，是因为大家都见过那个故障。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_TECH_WORKERS_COM.zh_CN: 半夜三点提的故障单备注越短，说明这破问题大伙儿早就熟得不能再熟了。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_TECH_WORKERS_COM.en: The note is short because everyone has seen that fault.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_RETIREES_COMMENT.source: 椅子暂时撤走，话题却没少一个。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_RETIREES_COMMENT.zh_CN: 长椅拆去刷漆了也耽误不了他们唠嗑，站那张施工告示牌底下照样能聊一上午。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_RETIREES_COMMENT.en: The bench is gone for now. The conversation has lost nothing.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_DIASPORAS_COMMEN.source: 菜还没出锅，家里的旧称呼已经叫遍了。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_DIASPORAS_COMMEN.zh_CN: 这边刚下班那边才天亮，隔着屏幕教你放多少盐的时候，老家的小名还是叫得最顺嘴。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_GROUP_DIASPORAS_COMMEN.en: The family names have all been called before dinner is ready.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_IDENTITY_COMMENT.source: 表格留白以后，人们才开始认真填名字。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_IDENTITY_COMMENT.zh_CN: 以前全是勾选项没人多想，真在表上留出空栏让你自己填称呼，好多人倒捧着笔琢磨起来了。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_IDENTITY_COMMENT.en: Once the form leaves space, people start choosing their names carefully.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_LANGUAGE_COMMENT.source: 一个笑话译不顺，往往要先问清谁在笑。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_LANGUAGE_COMMENT.zh_CN: 一句双关语能折腾出十几种翻法，字幕组这帮人较起真来真是半个字都不肯让。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_LANGUAGE_COMMENT.en: Before fixing a translated joke, ask who is laughing.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_TRUST_COMMENT.source: 转发走得快，求证总要多走几步。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_TRUST_COMMENT.zh_CN: 传话的人早跑没影了，还得靠最早发帖的老实人把聊天记录从头到尾贴出来救场。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_TRUST_COMMENT.en: Forwarding is quick. Checking takes a few more steps.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_HOUSING_COMMENT.source: 租客关心的字，常藏在每页最下面。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_HOUSING_COMMENT.zh_CN: 房东突然说重印合同，换谁都得先拿放大镜去翻最底下那两行小字改了哪儿。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_HOUSING_COMMENT.en: The words tenants need are often near the bottom of the page.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_HEALTHCARE_COMME.source: 挂号的路讲清了，候诊室就少一点着急。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_HEALTHCARE_COMME.zh_CN: 医院挂号系统一改版，走廊长椅上坐着的病友往往比导医台讲得还接地气。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_HEALTHCARE_COMME.en: Clear booking instructions take some of the worry out of waiting.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_CLIMATE_COMMENT.source: 窗边那支温度计，终于有了同伴。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_CLIMATE_COMMENT.zh_CN: 天气预报报个平均数大家总觉得不解气，非得把自己窗台晒出来的度数贴上去比一比才舒坦。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_CLIMATE_COMMENT.en: The thermometer by the window finally has company.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_ENERGY_COMMENT.source: 一张停电单，能改掉整条街的晚饭时间。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_ENERGY_COMMENT.zh_CN: 一张计划停电的黄纸贴在电线杆上，整条街小老板今晚先干什么就全跟着它转了。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_ENERGY_COMMENT.en: An outage notice can change dinnertime along the whole street.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_FOOD_COMMENT.source: 同一道菜，排队的人能说出许多来处。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_FOOD_COMMENT.zh_CN: 排着队等试吃的时候最容易跟陌生人搭上话，聊上两句连自家放不放蒜的秘方都交代了。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_FOOD_COMMENT.en: The people in the queue can give the same dish several histories.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_TRANSPORT_COMMEN.source: 赶末班车的人，最记得时刻表改了哪一行。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_TRANSPORT_COMMEN.zh_CN: 白天坐车的人未必留意，天天踩着点赶末班车的那拨人，发车时间挪五分钟都能要了亲命。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_TRANSPORT_COMMEN.en: Last-bus passengers know exactly which line of the timetable changed.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_MIGRATION_COMMEN.source: 安顿下来之前，总要先问几遍路。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_MIGRATION_COMMEN.zh_CN: 刚搬来人生地不熟，居委会那张印着去哪儿交水费、哪天倒垃圾的多语纸条比什么欢迎词都实在。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_MIGRATION_COMMEN.en: Getting settled usually begins with asking directions more than once.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_TOURISM_COMMENT.source: 地图没印出来的小路，住客替它补上了。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_TOURISM_COMMENT.zh_CN: 旅游手册印得再漂亮，也不如前一个退房的人在背面用圆珠笔圈出来的那家早点铺好使。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_TOURISM_COMMENT.en: The guests add paths the printed map left out.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_TRADE_COMMENT.source: 等货的时候，日期上的每个字都格外显眼。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_TRADE_COMMENT.zh_CN: 船一晚点，买卖双方就得坐下来对着货单一字一句抠当初是怎么写的……这种场面谁都不想多碰。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_TRADE_COMMENT.en: When you are waiting for goods, every word beside the date stands out.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_SCIENCE_COMMENT.source: 数据抄下来以后，下一步是自己量一次。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_SCIENCE_COMMENT.zh_CN: 观测站刚贴出一页原始读数，底下那帮较真的发烧友已经搬出仪器准备自己验一遍了。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_SCIENCE_COMMENT.en: Once you have copied the readings, try taking your own.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_CARE_COMMENT.source: 轮值表上的空格，填的是谁能腾出一个下午。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_CARE_COMMENT.zh_CN: 楼道里挂的这张买菜取药轮班表看着不起眼，真能坚持每周不空档，比喊多少口号都难得。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_CARE_COMMENT.en: Each blank on the rota asks who can spare an afternoon.

LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_PUBLIC_SAFETY_CO.source: 报修单写得具体，别人才能找到那盏灯。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_PUBLIC_SAFETY_CO.zh_CN: 光写一句路灯坏了多半石沉大海，还是得拍张黑灯瞎火的现场照贴上去才有人来修。
LOC_EVENT_CONTEXT_TOPIC_PUBLIC_SAFETY_CO.en: A precise repair report helps someone find the right lamp.

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_S03_TITLE.source: “看不懂但震撼”成了万能回复
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_S03_TITLE.zh_CN: “看不懂但震撼”成了万能回复
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_S03_TITLE.en: "Impressed but confused" becomes a stock reply

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_S03_NARRATIVE.source: %s网友给复杂图解和离奇表演都配上“我看不懂，但我大受震撼”，评论区很快跟着复读。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_S03_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: %s网友给复杂图解和离奇表演都配上“我看不懂，但我大受震撼”，评论区很快跟着复读。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_S03_NARRATIVE.en: Users in %s caption complex diagrams and bizarre performances with "I don't understand it, but I am deeply impressed." The comments repeat it.

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_S03_COMMENT.source: 不懂也能参与，这句倒是给大家留了个位置。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_S03_COMMENT.zh_CN: 不懂也能参与，这句倒是给大家留了个位置。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_S03_COMMENT.en: You don't have to understand it to join in. Convenient, isn't it?

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_S03_POSITIVE.en: I don't get it. I'll be amazed first.

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_S03_NEGATIVE.source: 到底在夸，还是觉得太离谱？
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_S03_NEGATIVE.zh_CN: 到底在夸，还是觉得太离谱？
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_S03_NEGATIVE.en: Is that praise, or just disbelief?

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_S04_TITLE.en: "Lying flat" fills a performance review thread

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_S04_NARRATIVE.source: %s一场关于加码考核的讨论里，越来越多人用“我先躺平”回应，不再争谁能投入更多。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_S04_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: %s一场关于加码考核的讨论里，越来越多人用“我先躺平”回应，不再争谁能投入更多。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_S04_NARRATIVE.en: In %s, a debate about tougher performance targets fills with "I'm lying flat" replies instead of competing promises of more effort.

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_S04_COMMENT.source: 考核还在加，先有人把竞赛牌放下了。你猜后面会不会有人跟？
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_S04_COMMENT.zh_CN: 考核还在加，先有人把竞赛牌放下了。你猜后面会不会有人跟？
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_S04_COMMENT.en: The targets keep rising, but someone has put down their race number. Let's see who follows.

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_S04_POSITIVE.en: This round, I'd rather compete less.

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_S04_NEGATIVE.source: 退出以后，压力就会消失吗？
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_S04_NEGATIVE.zh_CN: 退出以后，压力就会消失吗？
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_S04_NEGATIVE.en: Does stepping out make the pressure disappear?

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_S16_TITLE.source: “巅峰之作”刷进比赛与影评区
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_S16_TITLE.zh_CN: “巅峰之作”刷进比赛与影评区
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_S16_TITLE.en: "Peak fiction" crosses from reviews into sports

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_S16_NARRATIVE.source: %s观众把精彩进球、剧情反转和粗糙恶搞都叫作“巅峰之作”，认真夸与开玩笑的评论混在一起。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_S16_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: %s观众把精彩进球、剧情反转和粗糙恶搞都叫作“巅峰之作”，认真夸与开玩笑的评论混在一起。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_S16_NARRATIVE.en: Viewers in %s call great goals, plot twists and rough joke videos "peak fiction," mixing sincere praise with exaggeration.

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_S16_COMMENT.source: 精彩的叫巅峰，离谱的也叫巅峰。你得看看他们在笑什么。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_S16_COMMENT.zh_CN: 精彩的叫巅峰，离谱的也叫巅峰。你得看看他们在笑什么。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_S16_COMMENT.en: Great scenes are peak. Absurd scenes are peak too. Watch what they're laughing at.

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_S16_NEGATIVE.source: 这也能封神，标准真灵活。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_S16_NEGATIVE.zh_CN: 这也能封神，标准真灵活。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_S16_NEGATIVE.en: Apparently anything can be crowned a masterpiece.

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_R02_TITLE.source: 一段沉默让“会更好吧”走红
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_R02_TITLE.zh_CN: 一段沉默让“会更好吧”走红
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_R02_TITLE.en: A silent pause makes "better, right?" spread

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_R02_NARRATIVE.source: %s有人把新方案说明剪成问答：一人保证要改变，另一人追问“会更好吧”，镜头却迟迟不给回答。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_R02_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: %s有人把新方案说明剪成问答：一人保证要改变，另一人追问“会更好吧”，镜头却迟迟不给回答。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_R02_NARRATIVE.en: An edit in %s pairs a promise of change with "For the better, right?" The camera lingers without an answer.

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_R02_COMMENT.source: 沉默也能传话，而且听着还挺让人心慌。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_R02_COMMENT.zh_CN: 沉默也能传话，而且听着还挺让人心慌。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_R02_COMMENT.en: Silence can say plenty. This one sounds rather worrying.

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_R02_POSITIVE.source: 先把没说完的后果问清楚。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_R02_POSITIVE.zh_CN: 先把没说完的后果问清楚。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_R02_POSITIVE.en: Ask about the consequences left unsaid.

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_R02_NEGATIVE.source: 说要改变，可没说会变好。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_R02_NEGATIVE.zh_CN: 说要改变，可没说会变好。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_R02_NEGATIVE.en: A promise of change leaves the result open.

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_R06_TITLE.en: "Everyone raises the stakes" starts an involution thread

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_R06_NARRATIVE.source: %s学生和上班族接力晒出越拉越长的任务清单，用“内卷”概括投入增加、回报却没变的处境。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_R06_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: %s学生和上班族接力晒出越拉越长的任务清单，用“内卷”概括投入增加、回报却没变的处境。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_R06_NARRATIVE.en: Students and workers in %s share growing task lists, calling the rising effort without better rewards "involution."

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_R06_COMMENT.source: 清单越写越长，回报还在原地。怪不得这两个字有人接。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_R06_COMMENT.zh_CN: 清单越写越长，回报还在原地。怪不得这两个字有人接。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_R06_COMMENT.en: The lists keep growing and the rewards stay put. No wonder that word catches on.

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_R06_POSITIVE.source: 大家都想从无效竞争里喘口气。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_R06_POSITIVE.zh_CN: 大家都想从无效竞争里喘口气。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_R06_POSITIVE.en: People want a break from fruitless competition.

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_R06_NEGATIVE.source: 忙得更多，就一定做得更多吗？
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_R06_NEGATIVE.zh_CN: 忙得更多，就一定做得更多吗？
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_R06_NEGATIVE.en: Does being busier mean achieving more?

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_R07_TITLE.en: Activity buddies spread beyond lunch plans

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_R07_NARRATIVE.source: %s的同城帖子开始分别招饭搭子、学习搭子和散步搭子，发帖人先说明活动，再约定相处边界。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_R07_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: %s的同城帖子开始分别招饭搭子、学习搭子和散步搭子，发帖人先说明活动，再约定相处边界。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_R07_NARRATIVE.en: Local posts in %s seek separate lunch, study and walking buddies, spelling out the activity and expectations first.

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_R07_COMMENT.source: 先约好一起做什么，认识起来省事多了。别忘了看看对方答应了什么。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_R07_COMMENT.zh_CN: 先约好一起做什么，认识起来省事多了。别忘了看看对方答应了什么。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_R07_COMMENT.en: Agreeing on what to do makes meeting easier. Just read what the other person agreed to.

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_R07_POSITIVE.en: Doing this one thing together is enough.

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_R07_NEGATIVE.source: 活动合拍，也得慢慢建立信任。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_R07_NEGATIVE.zh_CN: 活动合拍，也得慢慢建立信任。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_R07_NEGATIVE.en: Sharing an activity still takes trust.

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_P03_TITLE.source: “退退退”被拿来驱赶日常烦恼
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_P03_TITLE.zh_CN: “退退退”被拿来驱赶日常烦恼
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_P03_TITLE.en: "Back, back, back" chases away everyday troubles

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_P03_NARRATIVE.source: %s短视频里，人们对着加班通知、坏天气和倒霉经历挥手跺脚，齐喊“退退退”。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_P03_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: %s短视频里，人们对着加班通知、坏天气和倒霉经历挥手跺脚，齐喊“退退退”。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_P03_NARRATIVE.en: Videos in %s show people shooing away overtime notices, bad weather and bad luck with repeated cries of "Back!"

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_P03_COMMENT.source: 喊完不一定有用，倒是很适合让旁边的人跟着喊。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_P03_COMMENT.zh_CN: 喊完不一定有用，倒是很适合让旁边的人跟着喊。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_P03_COMMENT.en: It may not change the weather, but it's easy for everyone else to shout along.

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_P03_POSITIVE.source: 今天先把烦心事赶远一点。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_P03_POSITIVE.zh_CN: 今天先把烦心事赶远一点。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_P03_POSITIVE.en: Let's shoo the trouble away for today.

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_P03_NEGATIVE.en: The notice is still there. Now the voice is gone.

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_P11_NARRATIVE.source: %s学生听到六和七就接上喊声，再把双手交替抬起。有人认真追问含义，其他人只又做了一遍。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_P11_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: %s学生听到六和七就接上喊声，再把双手交替抬起。有人认真追问含义，其他人只又做了一遍。

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_P11_POSITIVE.en: Hear the numbers and everyone joins in.

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_P20_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: %s创作者用开心猫、哭泣猫和愤怒猫演出通勤、考试与家庭对话，熟悉片段换上新字幕又能接着讲。

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_P20_COMMENT.source: 演员还是那几只猫，今天演的又是谁的生活？
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_P20_COMMENT.zh_CN: 演员还是那几只猫，今天演的又是谁的生活？

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_P20_POSITIVE.zh_CN: 不用露脸，也能把心情讲清楚。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_P20_POSITIVE.en: A mood can come across without showing a face.

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_P20_NEGATIVE.en: The cats have acted out my entire day.

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_W07_NEGATIVE.en: One mistake and all those points are gone.

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_W10_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: %s网友给独自散步、坐车和看雨的片段配上电影音乐，把普通一天剪成自己的主角时刻。

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_W10_COMMENT.en: The walk is the same. Add music and even waiting at a crossing feels dramatic.

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_W10_POSITIVE.source: 今天也值得有自己的镜头。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_W10_POSITIVE.zh_CN: 今天也值得有自己的镜头。

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_W10_NEGATIVE.source: 主角看得见，路人也在画面里。

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_W10_NEGATIVE.en: The lead is visible. So are all the passersby.

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_B07_POSITIVE.source: 休息一下，先把精神养回来。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_B07_POSITIVE.zh_CN: 休息一下，先把精神养回来。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_B07_POSITIVE.en: Take a break and get some energy back.

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_B07_NEGATIVE.source: 这张脸像刚开完第三场会。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_B07_NEGATIVE.zh_CN: 这张脸像刚开完第三场会。
LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_B07_NEGATIVE.en: That face looks fresh from its third meeting.

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_B14_COMMENT.en: The quicker the promise, the easier the screenshot is to find later. Don't get too confident.

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_B14_POSITIVE.en: You can leave this one to me.

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_B15_NARRATIVE.zh_CN: %s学生和上班族晒出被难题、截止时间或高强度任务击败的瞬间，配文只剩“已老实，求放过”。

LOC_EVENT_ENVIRONMENT_CASE_B15_POSITIVE.en: Concede this round and catch your breath.
